name: Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA)
summary: Use horizontal autoscaling to respond to CPU pressure and request load while keeping latency within SLOs.

use_when.message: Sustained high CPU suggests scale-out can reduce saturation.

avoid_when.message: If DB is a critical dependency, scaling app pods may amplify DB load unless guarded.

solutions: Enable HPA using CPU (and optionally latency/custom metrics) targets
Set sane max replicas and scale-up policies to avoid sudden load spikes
Confirm downstream dependencies (DB, caches) can handle increased concurrency
tradeoffs: Can shift bottlenecks to downstream services
